articles.title: Backyard Astrophotography: How to Shoot Planets Like a Pro
articles.summary: You can photograph Jupiter's bands and Saturn's rings with a modest telescope and camera. The trick is 'lucky imaging'—recording video and stacking the sharpest frames. No observatory needed!

articles.title: Webb's Infrared Gaze Reveals a Cosmic Lion Sculpted by a Dying Star
articles.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope captured a new view of the Lion Nebula, revealing hidden dust and gas. This cosmic lion was created by a dying star whose white dwarf core 'cooks' the nebula from within.

articles.title: ADHD: Not a Disorder, But a Different Way of Thinking
articles.summary: ADHD affects how people focus and learn, but it's a natural brain variation, not a flaw. About 22 million Americans have it, including 6 million kids. It's linked to creativity and even helped ancient foragers!
